gap: No result ChatGPT got names the one expansion pack that fits the Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 (Anker SOLIX BP2000 (Gen 2), up to 4 kWh) together with its 12V⎓10A car-charger output and Anker's own claim of 9 W idle draw and 7 days on a portable fridge.
standout_why: I opened solarwaypoint.com's C2000 Gen 2 / AC200L / DELTA 2 Max comparison. It gives maximum expanded capacity (4,096 / 8,192 / 6,144 Wh) and says each model has one 12V socket. It does not name which expansion packs fit, and it gives no volt or amp rating for the car outlet. It says nothing about ECO or auto-off. The cited EcoFlow manual PDFs give the DELTA 2 Max car outlet as 12.6V/10A, and ChatGPT's answer repeats that. buyerdecision.com (403) and stationarena.com (TLS error) would not load, so I could not check them. The finding that would have decided the pick is whether each station's 12V port shuts itself off while a fridge compressor is cycling. I could not open a maker document for it, so it is in unsourced and not counted here.
decides: The C2000 Gen 2 confirmation is weak: its 12V port is the standard 10 A socket a compressor fridge needs. The BP2000 (Gen 2) is the only pack Anker names for it, so a shopper who wants more than 3 days with no sun knows which battery to add. The pick still depends on the unsourced auto-off check below. If BLUETTI's DC ECO mode or EcoFlow's 12V DC timeout can turn the car port off between compressor cycles, the page has to tell shoppers which setting to change for a 72-hour run.

findings.label: 12V car outlet rating
findings.value: 12 V⎓10 A (Anker lists no wattage; 12 × 10 = 120 W)
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 product page (Anker SOLIX US)
findings.note: Spec table reads 'Car Charger Output: 12V⎓10A'. The 120 W is my arithmetic, not Anker's figure.

findings.label: Compatible expansion battery
findings.value: Anker SOLIX BP2000 (Gen 2); up to 4 kWh total
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 product page (Anker SOLIX US)
findings.note: The FAQ says the unit 'can be paired with Anker SOLIX BP2000 (Gen 2) to expand capacity'. The page also says 'Up to 4kWh Expandable Capacity'. No other pack is named.

findings.label: Idle draw and fridge runtime (maker claim)
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 product page (Anker SOLIX US)
findings.note: This is Anker's own claim and the page gives no test conditions. The page does not say whether the 9 W is with only DC on or with AC on. The same page claims 32 h on a dual-door fridge, or 64 h with the expansion battery.

findings.label: What rival comparison pages state about 12V ports and expansion
findings.value: One 12V socket per model, no V/A rating; maximum expanded Wh only, no pack model names; no mention of ECO or auto-off
findings.source_title: Anker Solix C2000 Gen 2 vs Bluetti AC200L vs EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max Comparison - Solar Waypoint
findings.note: This page sets the baseline the standout score is judged against.
